name: Born to Obey
source:
Hadron's life is falling apart. After losing his job and struggling with addiction, he's trapped in a suffocating haze. One night, a stranger enters his life and unsettles the fragile balance he clings to.

[From [url=https://rekion.itch.io/born-to-obey]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
强子的生活正在崩溃。失去工作并与毒瘾作斗争后，他陷入了令人窒息的阴霾之中。一天晚上，一名陌生人闯入了他的生活，打破了他所坚守的脆弱平衡。

[来自[url=https://rekion.itch.io/born-to-obey]itch.io[/url]]
